summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Revival Pro. Backend pytest suite (11 tests) covering auth, dashboard, clients CRUD, estimates (compute+convert idempotency), jobs+expenses, invoices+payment update — all PASSED. Frontend UI verified via Playwright with Bearer localStorage auth: login page, dashboard KPIs, navigation across 5 modules, client add flow, estimate dialog + convert-estimate buttons on Won estimates, jobs Budget/Committed/Actual + log expense, invoices stat boxes + record payment, and logout redirect — all working.

minor.issue: create_invoice has confusing logic: 'amount = total if not amount else amount' — never overrides zero amount when line_items exist; also compute_totals return value re-derives amount incorrectly if caller sends amount=0. Consider always deriving from line_items when provided.
Endpoint converts any estimate regardless of status (spec says Won-only). Currently permissive — main agent should decide if this is intentional.
Uses count_documents() which is not concurrency-safe and can produce duplicate numbers after deletions. Consider a counters collection with findOneAndUpdate.

issues: Page heading 'Invoices' + subtitle appear very low-contrast against the dark teal marble background — heading blends in. Consider lighter/white text or a card wrapper.
Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — accessibility improvement, add DialogDescription for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional) Restrict /api/estimates/{id}/convert to Won status only, or document current behaviour.
(Optional) Improve invoice create amount derivation logic.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to modals for accessibility.
(Optional) Increase contrast for page headings on the dark background.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 640 lines and monolithic — consider splitting by domain (clients/estimates/jobs/invoices/auth) once app grows.
next_number relies on document count → race condition & renumber-after-delete risk.
Convert endpoint does not enforce status=='Won'.
Invoice amount derivation branch is a no-op when caller supplies amount=0.
compute_totals returns dicts (not LineItem objects); reconstructed later — OK but inconsistent.
get_current_user parses ISO expires_at each call → cheap but consider storing as native datetime.
test_credentials: Bearer/Cookie session_token='test_session_verify' for user verify@example.com (restored after logout test, expires ~180d). Owner account: tccrossmusic@gmail.com (Google OAuth).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup: 6 clients, 6 estimates (2 Won, 2 Follow-up, 1 Sent, 1 Draft), 2 jobs, 2 invoices. Tests create TEST_-prefixed data and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend requires localStorage bearer approach — go to /login first, evaluate localStorage.setItem('session_token','test_session_verify'), then goto('/'). The shared session token is restored after each run. All data-testids present and functional: kpi-*, nav-*, add-client-btn, client-*-input, save-client-btn, add-estimate-btn, add-line-item-btn, estimate-total, save-estimate-btn, convert-estimate-{id}, log-expense (per job), edit-invoice-{id}, user-menu-btn, logout-btn, google-login-btn.
